name: Jerry
long_description:
Your car and your home are your most expensive assets. And for most people, these aren't just purchases, they're the physical embodiment of the life you've worked hard to build. Yet the experience of owning them is stuck in the 90s. Every step of the journey — buying, insuring, maintaining, repairing, selling — is fragmented, complicated, and expensive.

Imagine having a trusted friend in your pocket who takes care of everything: they find you the right car or home at the right price, lock in the best insurance rate without you lifting a finger, remind you before that service appointment turns into an expensive repair or, worse, an accident, and help you sell at the best price when the time is right. That friend is Jerry.

Jerry is building the first AI agent to manage all your physical assets. We started with car insurance in 2019, became one of the top 3 brokers in the U.S., then added driving insights, diagnostics, and a repair marketplace. We've reached 5M+ customers, raised $240M+, and have been profitable since 2024. We're now expanding into home, motorcycle, RV, and beyond.

We’re fully remote with offices in Palo Alto, New York, Chicago, and Toronto.
one_liner: Jerry is building the AI agent to manage all your physical assets.

question_answers.question: How did your company get started? (i.e., How did the founders meet? How did you come up with the idea? How did you decide to be a founder?)
question_answers.answer: My co-founders, Lina Zhang and Musawir Shah, and I worked together at my previous startup, YourMechanic, a company that provides mobile automotive repair and maintenance services to vehicle owners at their location. Through that experience and our own personal, frustrating experiences with all car ownership hassles, we knew this was a category ripe for disruption. From determining what car to buy, financing a vehicle, finding insurance, licensing, titles, warranties, repairs, parking, and maintenance, we saw very clearly that services for car owners were lagging behind the ease and convenience offered in other industries. We wanted to remove the friction and make the transactions seamless and less expensive. The three of us set out to launch a product that would solve these hassles for car owners. We started with a car insurance compare-and-buy service that quickly gained traction _Since then we have helped more than 3 million customers shop for car insurance. We’ve also expanded our vision from a car insurance shopping site to a car ownership super app. That is because car insurance is just one of the expensive hassles car owners experience. Today, in addition to our car insurance marketplace, our app helps customers with auto refinancing, safe driving and more._

question_answers.question: What is the core problem you are solving? Why is this a big problem? What made you decide to work on it?
question_answers.answer: Owning a car is the second largest American household expense. And, so many components of car ownership are complicated and outdated, like buying insurance and refinancing an auto loan. It is a big problem because owning a car should make your life easier but in many ways it makes it more complicated. Through my own experience, I learned that owning a car is not the “American dream” I hoped it would be, but rather, it’s expensive, frustrating and time consuming.We decided to build a product that takes the frustration out of car ownership – starting with shopping for and buying insurance – and makes it easy to save. Through our AI-backed insurance marketplace, car owners can automatically shop from more than 55 top U.S. car insurance companies in 45 seconds and complete the transaction in minutes. This approach to revamping the insurance shopping experience worked and it saves Jerry customers, on average, more than $800 per year.We applied this same automated technology to our auto refinancing marketplace, which takes a typical end-to-end process of 19 days down to less than 48 hours. And our goal is to shrink that even further. _Through insurance and refinancing we’ve started solving the small problems that contribute to the massive frustration that is car ownership in the U.S._

question_answers.question: What is your long-term vision? If you truly succeed, what will be different about the world?
question_answers.answer: The long term vision is to create a car ownership super app that supports drivers with all their expensive car hassles, saving them both time and money. Today, we do that through our car insurance and auto refinancing marketplaces, and we offer customers rewards for safe driving with our Drive Well, Earn Perks program. But these aren’t the only expenses drivers incur, which means there are many other opportunities for Jerry to support our customers, with things like maintenance, parking, and more._We want to solve all of those issues. When drivers no longer have to worry about car ownership hassles because they know Jerry is doing the work to save them time and money, we will have achieved our goal._

founders.founder_bio:
Co-Founder at Jerry.ai, currently leading legal, people ops, and recruiting. 

Prior to Jerry, I scaled operations and supply at YourMechanic (YC W12). Before that, I was a biochemist-turned-attorney specializing in intellectual property and patents at Morrison Foerster. 

Lifelong student and forever in pursuit of mastery.
